chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: In today's video, I am going to explain what are anomalies or outliers and what are their types.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Actually, the sooner the outliers are detected, the better.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: And especially when we do data pre-processing, data cleaning etc.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: At the same time, if we detect outliers and remove them from our data set,

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: then our results are better and more optimized.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: The simple reason for this is that outliers are such data points

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: that deviate significantly from the normal patterns in the data set.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Let's suppose my maximum data point is lying on a particular point.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: But there is one data point which is far away from all these.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So, if you remove any mean, median or mode, then obviously, this will also participate.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: When this will participate, then the result can go bad.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: That's why we want you to know what are outliers and remove them as soon as possible from your data set.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So that you can find your patterns on the correct data.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So, always remember this point.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Now, if we talk about anomalies or outliers, then the first thing that comes is point anomaly.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It's a very simple topic.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: There is no big concept in this.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: No, it's very easy.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It's also called global outlier.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: What does it mean?

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It's a single data point that is very different from the rest of the data.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: As I told you in the diagram, maximum data point is lying here and one is lying separately.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Let's say, the electricity bill of your house is between 1000-5000.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: But, in a month, it comes to 50,000.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Now, this is an outlier.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It will get triggered suddenly.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Now, you will also get wrong triggered that how did this come to 50,000?

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Maybe something went wrong there.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So, what is that thing called?

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It's called point anomaly or global outlier.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Means, all the other points are close.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: One went so far that your system got messed up.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So, it's important to point out this.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: Then comes your contextual anomaly which is called conditional outlier.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: What does conditional outlier mean?

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It will be fine in one condition.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: In the other condition, it may seem wrong to you.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: It means that if the temperature is 30 degrees in summers,

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: then you will find it normal.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: 30 is less, it can be more than this.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: But, if the temperature is 30 degrees in winters,

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: then you will find it abnormal or outlier.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: So, it means contextual.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: In context, it is fine in one context and in the other context, it is wrong.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: For example, take the example of heartbeat.

chunks.title: Anomalies_Outliers in Data Mining
chunks.text: You are running a marathon or doing a simple sprint.

chunks.text: So, that is the thing that you should know.
